notes.note: Member search with an unknown number shows exactly: "No member records matched your search." — a legitimate business result, not a failure.

Submitting Continue with the Initial Deposit blank returns a page headed OPEN NEW SHARE with "The request could not be validated: Initial deposit must be a valid dollar figure." and a "Return to Open New Share" link. Returning resets the Share Type dropdown to S0001 - Regular Shares, so it must be re-selected.

finish.name: Open New Share for Member
finish.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console as an operator, looks up a member by member number, runs the Open New Share action for a chosen share type and initial deposit, confirms on the CONFIRM NEW SHARE review screen and commits. Returns the confirmation number, new share ID, share type description and opening balance. This writes data: it creates a real new share account on the member record.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the console.

inputs.name: shareType
inputs.description: Visible option text of the share type to open in the Share Type dropdown.

inputs.name: initialDeposit
inputs.description: Initial deposit amount in dollars, e.g. [REDACTED:SECRET]. Must be a valid dollar figure.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: Confirmation number for the share opening.
outputs.label: Confirmation:

outputs.name: newShareId
outputs.description: Identifier of the newly created share.
outputs.label: New Share ID:

outputs.description: Description of the opened share type.
outputs.label: Type:

outputs.name: openingBalance
outputs.description: Opening balance of the new share.
